adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration loops over legacy `embeddable_hosts` lines and does `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"`. Since `h` is interpolated directly into a single-quoted SQL string with no escaping/quoting helper, any legacy value containing a `'` will produce invalid SQL and can break the migration (and is generally unsafe SQL construction).
